## CELL FACTS

Cell 火_七杀 (Fire carrying The General). Persona The General (七杀). Definition line: "Pressure that doesn't grant permission, the trial that forges". Keyword Force, charge fierce, poles catalyst Command / friction Harshness. Family function: Order. Cost dimension: pressure that does not ask permission; peace can feel like demotion. Arena: forge, campaign, the weight of command, tempering. Classical portrait: pressure as clarity; the trial that forges; force without permission; peace felt as demotion. Ruled domains: Pressure, Command, Crisis. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正官.
Element arena: Fire (flame, light, warmth, fuel, the hearth, the blaze). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Fire pressing Metal same-polarity — the forge that doesn't moderate itself".
- k2_overview: "Your Fire moves as the General: heat weaponized into will. You command like a charge, blazing conviction that armies of ordinary people find themselves following. Crisis makes you luminous. Peacetime makes you dangerous to furniture. Aim the cannon, always. Unaimed, this much fire tests every relationship it warms."
- k2_functional: "Your order is fire discipline: absolute at the front, enforced on yourself before anyone else feels it."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Too intense","Bossy","Burned-out"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Pressure":"Pressure ignites you: stakes convert your heat into focus. Without real battles you invent them, so keep a worthy campaign running at all times, professional or physical.","Command":"You command by fire: vision hot enough to melt objections. Troops follow the light. Mind the scorch radius, and let cooler officers handle the discipline your heat would burn.","Crisis":"Crisis is your parade ground: you charge while others count. Victory loves you. Afterward, check who got trampled in the charge, including you."}

- Sibling cell 火_正官 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Upstanding","Squeaky-clean","Inspiring"],"friction":["Stern","Appearance-bound","Overextended"]}
- Sibling cell 火_正官 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "You conduct yourself like someone permanently on camera, and the footage would hold up. The taxes are clean, the promises kept, the small ethics observed when nobody is checking. In a dim market, your reputation shines at a distance, and it was polished entirely by boring choices."

Core element Metal, energy element Fire. Law: Fire tames Metal (火克金: the forge softens the blade). Relative to the core the energy is the tamer, so Fire is this core's Order. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Fire on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Fire as the Order is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 金_火's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: Pressure is where your thinking gets clear and sure. Since nothing else makes you this sure of yourself, you take the hard version of a job ahead of the easy one. Once in a while pick a stake that is real rather than one you invented, because you think as well under those.

value_b.text: You think best when something is at stake. Because a stake you cannot lose never feels like yours, you choose being judged on a hard thing rather than praised for an easy one. Give yourself one hard thing a month on purpose, since you do your clearest work inside it.

value.text: Whenever the pressure lifts, your focus goes with it, which is why a quiet week feels less like rest than like a punishment. You chase the next hard thing ahead of the sleep your body is asking for. Let the quiet week count as rest, since you need somewhere to come back from.

value.text: Bringing pressure into a calm place is something you do without noticing. Since you think better with stakes, you raise them for everyone near you rather than only for yourself. Save the stakes for the fights that need them, because you take a calm evening from the people at home each time you do.

value.text: Command comes to you before anyone hands it over. Standing by while a group drifts feels worse to you than being wrong out loud, so you take the decision ahead of the vote. Hand the next one over on purpose, because you lead better when you have chosen to.

value_b.text: You end up in charge wherever the lead is open. Being the one who decides counts for more than being the one who is right, so you speak first and check later. Let someone else go first sometimes, since you do not need the title to lead.

value.text: Whenever you take the lead, you also take the weight that comes with it. You feel safer making a decision alone rather than sharing it, so you go too long without being carried yourself. Let one person in on the load, because you were never meant to hold yourself up alone.

value.text: An ordinary week feels to you like being passed over. Because you only feel fully awake with something at risk, you pick the job with a chance of failing ahead of the safe one. Keep one of those going somewhere in your life, since you were built to be tested rather than kept safe.

value_b.text: You come alive when the outcome is not safe. Peace reads to you as being left out, so you carry a real risk rather than a sure thing. Choose the risk with your eyes open, because you are most yourself where something is on the line.

ledger[6]._trace: peace felt as demotion: the reader seeks risk because safety reads as being benched

value.text: Whenever life goes quiet, you feel like you are losing, which is why calm never feels like a reward to you. You spend rest as fast as it comes in, long before anyone asks. Let the quiet stretch be the prize rather than the gap, because you have one body to spend.

value.text: Raising the stakes is how you make a day feel real. Since an easy win bores you more than a hard loss, you turn plans that were working into tests they did not need to be. Keep the test for yourself, because you take the plain good day away from the people around you.
